# Requirements Quality Checklist: English (All Specs)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for requirements writing quality across all feature specs (001-006)
**Created**: 2026-08-28
**Feature**: All specs in `specs/`

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are non-functional requirements (error handling, concurrency, performance, accessibility) defined across all specs? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does spec 001 (Loyalty) define what happens when a customer's loyalty card does not yet exist at the moment of payment? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 - Does spec 002 (Inventory) define the behavior when two concurrent orders race for the same last item and both hit the database at the exact same millisecond? [Gap, Concurrency]
- [ ] CHK004 - Does spec 004 (Table Slugs) define how long a visit lasts and what "clearly ended" means in concrete terms (time threshold, staff action, explicit scan-out)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-5]
- [ ] CHK005 - Does spec 005 (Kitchen Messages) define what happens if the kitchen screen is closed or no staff is signed in when a customer message arrives? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 - Does spec 006 (Permissions) explicitly define the full permission matrix for every role × screen combination instead of leaving items marked "TO CLARIFY"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-3]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are rollback or failure-recovery requirements defined for any spec where a transaction could partially fail (e.g., loyalty points awarded but order state not updated)? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK008 - Does spec 003 (Order Type) define what happens if a delivery order is placed but the address field is corrupted or unreadable? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 - Is "clearly ended" in spec 004 (Table Slugs, §FR-5) quantified with a specific time threshold or triggering condition? [Clarity, Spec §FR-5]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "sensible default" in spec 003 (Order Type, §FR-4) defined with the exact default value and when it applies? [Clarity, Spec §FR-4]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "override" in spec 002 (Inventory, §FR-5) defined with the exact UI flow, confirmation steps, and whether it is logged? [Clarity, Spec §FR-5]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "in progress" in spec 005 (Kitchen Messages, §FR-6) defined with the exact order states that qualify? [Clarity, Spec §FR-6]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "message waiting" marker in spec 005 (Kitchen Messages, §FR-4) defined with specific visual properties (color, icon, position)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-4]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the phrase "the shop has already configured" in spec 001 (Loyalty, §Rules) clear about what configuration exists and where it lives? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-3]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is "clearly which item is unavailable" in spec 002 (Inventory, §Rules) defined with the exact messaging format shown to the customer? [Clarity]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 - Are the role definitions consistent between spec 006 (Permissions) §Who Uses It and the existing role model described in the constitution (Principle II)? [Consistency, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK017 - Does spec 001 (Loyalty) requirement that "points land on the card belonging to the customer name on the order" conflict with any customer identity model in other specs? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are the order state transitions consistent between spec 001 (Loyalty: payment confirmed → Preparing), spec 003 (Order Type), and spec 005 (Kitchen Messages: order in progress)? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK019 - Do spec 002 (Inventory) stock deduction requirements align with spec 001 (Loyalty) item-counting requirements when an order contains out-of-stock overridden items? [Consistency, Conflict]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 - Can the acceptance criterion "the reward appears on their card automatically" (spec 001, §How We'll Know) be objectively measured without interpreting "automatically"? [Measurability, Spec §FR-2]
- [ ] CHK021 - Can "stock counts never go below zero" (spec 002, §Rules) be verified for concurrent scenarios, or does it only describe the post-condition? [Measurability]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are acceptance criteria in spec 006 (Permissions) mutually exclusive with the "TO CLARIFY" items, creating a risk of untestable criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-3]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is "neither can see the other order's details" (spec 006, §How We'll Know) specific enough about what constitutes "details" (items, name, address, messages)? [Clarity]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where a customer places a QR-menu order and a counter order simultaneously for the same table? [Coverage, Spec 004]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where a loyalty reward is earned and redeemed in the same order? [Coverage, Spec 001]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where a staff override on inventory (spec 002) is later corrected by the shop owner adjusting stock counts? [Coverage, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where a kitchen message is sent after the order has moved to a terminal state (completed/cancelled) between the customer's send and the server processing it? [Coverage, Spec 005]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are requirements defined for what happens when a customer tries to scan a QR sticker for a table that has been deleted from the admin? [Coverage, Spec 004, Edge Case]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 - Are requirements defined for the behavior when a customer's device goes offline mid-order across any of the ordering-related specs (001, 002, 003, 004)? [Gap, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are requirements defined for the maximum number of items in a single order and whether stock checking degrades under large orders? [Gap, Performance]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for what happens when a table's QR sticker is scanned by a device that already has an active visit at a different table? [Edge Case, Spec 004]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK032 - Are accessibility requirements defined for the kitchen message screen (spec 005) — keyboard navigation, screen reader support, color contrast for the "message waiting" marker? [Gap, Accessibility]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are performance requirements defined for real-time message delivery between customer and kitchen (spec 005) — maximum acceptable latency? [Gap, Performance]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are audit trail requirements defined for inventory overrides (spec 002) — who overrode, when, which item, original count? [Gap, Audit]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are data retention requirements defined for customer messages (spec 005) — how long are message histories kept? [Gap, Retention]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 - Is the assumption that "the existing low-stock warning stays as it is" (spec 002, §What It Does Not) validated against the current implementation to confirm it actually exists? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK037 - Is the dependency on the "shop's loyalty settings" (spec 001, §Rules) documented — who configures them, where they live, what happens if they are missing or invalid? [Dependency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is the assumption that QR-menu customers always pick a table (spec 003, §Who Uses It) validated — what if a customer scans but doesn't select a table? [Assumption, Edge Case]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK039 - Does the phrase "the conversation closes when the order is completed or cancelled" (spec 005, §What It Does Not) conflict with the requirement that kitchen staff can "read the whole back-and-forth" after the order ends? [Conflict, Spec §FR-6]
- [ ] CHK040 - Is the constitution's Principle III ("money and records are append-only") fully addressed in specs 001 and 002 where stock and loyalty points mutate? [Traceability, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK041 - Does the constitution's Principle I ("offline-always") impose requirements on specs 001, 002, 003, 004, and 005 that are not explicitly stated in those specs? [Conflict, Constitution §I]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
